runs.text: Read two numbers and show them as
receives both boxes and leaves the smaller in the first and the larger in the second; the main algorithm only reads, calls and shows.

hints.text: When do you have to change something and when not?
It is the swap of the previous exercise, done only when needed.
Both boxes have to come back changed: lend them.
If the first is greater than the second, swap them. Close with the variant.

runs.text: also return whether it had to swap.
Hidden cases: equal, negatives and already sorted. Frequent mistake: passing the boxes by value, which shows the original order.

assertions.name: SortTwo
assertions.requirement: The subprogram SortTwo, which receives both boxes, is missing.
